items.title: SoundHound AI (SOUN) Stock May Be Pricey Following Fresh CXM AI Recognition

items.title: What Does Everest Group (EG) Lawsuit Mean For Reserve Transparency?
items.summary: Everest Group (NYSE:EG) faces a newly filed securities class action alleging misleading disclosures on casualty risk exposure and loss reserves. The complaint targets Everest Group executives over statements about reserve practices and the adequacy of loss reserves across casualty lines. Plaintiffs claim long running issues with risk concentration and reserve sufficiency that they argue distorted Everest Group’s reported financial risk profile.
